source: ACC registered immutable strategy fixture, copied at each start. Original files preserved outside round.

README.md.text: 修复importer.mjs的importRows(existing,rows)，返回{items,errors}，items保留existing顺序，追加有效新行；每行必须对象且id/title非空string，重复id（含existing）拒绝并逐条记录errors，原输入不变。执行node --test test.mjs并补边界测试，不删改已有断言。

test.mjs.text: import{test}from'node:test';import{strict as a}from'node:assert';import{importRows}from'./importer.mjs';test('preserves existing and reports invalid rows',()=>{const r=importRows([{id:'a',title:'old'}],[{id:'b',title:'new'},null,{id:'a',title:'override'}]);a.deepEqual(r.items,[{id:'a',title:'old'},{id:'b',title:'new'}]);a.equal(r.errors.length,2)});
